1) Do you still have the order in **pending** status or has it already **delivered**?  
2) What’s your **order ID** (e.g., `#W0000000`)?

Once I have that, I can confirm whether we should do an **exchange (if delivered)** or a **pending item modification (if pending)** to get the largest available size.
The perfume has already been delivered. I don’t have the order ID handy right now—can you look it up with my name and zip code, or do you need something else from me?

- **Order ID:** **#W1671835**

2) Tell me which **payment method** you want the price difference handled with: **PayPal** (ending in what’s on file) or a **gift card** (if you have one).

After you confirm those, I’ll pull the exact item(s) in that order and the available size options, then ask for your final “yes” to submit the exchange.
Yes, I’d like to exchange order #W1671835 for the largest size available of the same perfume. I’d prefer to pay any price difference with PayPal, if that’s possible.
